# Filter rows where Placing is 1 (first place)
first_places = df[df['Placing'] == 1]
# Count first places per rider
rider_counts = first_places['Rider'].value_counts()
# Find the rider(s) with the maximum count
max_count = rider_counts.max()
top_riders = rider_counts[rider_counts == max_count].index.tolist()
# Return the top rider(s) as a comma-separated string if multiple, else single name
answer = ', '.join(sorted(top_riders))
